name: common_gaussian_rank_copula
population: An equally weighted synthetic mixture of M50, M60, F50 and F60 community-adult strata, using the supplied anatomical-hand marginal values.
pairing_law: Within each cell, draw independent latent bivariate standard-normal pairs with common Pearson correlation rho. Associate the supplied right and left order statistics according to the corresponding latent ranks. Draw independently across cells.

dependence_parameter.rule: For each reference cell let a=right_sd/right_mean, b=left_sd/left_mean and c=ratio_sd/ratio_mean. Calculate rho_cell=(a*a+b*b-c*c)/(2*a*b). Set rho to the arithmetic mean of the four rho_cell values.
dependence_parameter.interpretation: A working calibration obtained by transporting relative individual-ratio dispersion and using a first-order delta approximation. It is not an observed inter-hand correlation.

marginal_policy: Preserve every supplied marginal value exactly. Do not rescale, truncate, add trial-level error, or reinterpret anatomical side as dominance.
finite_sample_policy: Use ranks from an iid latent Gaussian sample rather than forcing an exact empirical correlation. The permutation distribution, not each realized empirical correlation, follows the specified law.
